confdir.description: The directory where chrony configuration files are located.

sourcedir.description: The directory where time sources found via DHCP are located.

sourcedir_sources_d.description: The directory where additional NTP sources are located.

keyfile.description: The file containing ID/key pairs for NTP authentication.

servers.description: A list of NTP servers with optional parameters.
